name: Rosemary
description: A hardy evergreen shrub with needle-like aromatic leaves and pale blue flowers, adding fragrance and flavour to any garden.

img.alt: An illustration of a curved diagonal rosemary sprig with long narrow green leaves
img.caption: Small flowers, plenty of character.

grow: Choose a warm, open, and sunny spot.
Use gritty, well-drained soil; they dislike sitting in wet ground.
Ensure good air circulation around the plant.
Prune lightly after flowering to maintain shape and prevent woody bases.
enjoy: Enjoy the aromatic scent in the garden on warm days.
Use fresh or dried sprigs for potatoes, bread, and roast vegetables.
Add flowering stems to fresh floral or herbal arrangements.
Provide a valuable nectar source for early pollinators.
